doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: Born 1906 on North Boulevard in Baton Rouge
summary: Ertegun begins the life questions; Darensbourg gives his birth date, July 9, 1906, and address.
